title: Đèn đường khuya
about: Round 15, mo-ao: B minor at 96 bpm, its tune low (D4-G5) in halves and quarters, a bass falling B-A-G, E#dim7 and C#m7b5 for the dark colour, a shimmer trembling above the tune where it swells; an original tune; the left hand open (a deep bass, the chord broken an octave above it).
